questions.q: What real condition caused Priya's phone to be paged most nights before the alert was tuned?
options: The nightly catalog import batch job pushed transaction log usage past 70% for a few minutes before clearing on its own
MERSQLPRD01 crashed every night at the same time
The nightly backup job silently failed every night
A hardware failure on the backup share triggered a false alarm nightly
questions.explain: A large batch insert is expected to spike transaction log usage temporarily — the original alert paged on the very first check that crossed threshold, even though the condition resolved itself.

questions.q: What real, built-in SQL Server command does Test-MeridianLogSpace use to check transaction log usage?
options: DBCC SQLPERF(LOGSPACE)
DBCC CHECKDB
sp_who2
RESTORE VERIFYONLY
questions.explain: DBCC SQLPERF(LOGSPACE) is the real SQL Server command for per-database transaction log space usage, run here through Invoke-DbaQuery.

questions.q: In Send-MeridianAlert, which severity level actually pages Priya's phone?
options: Critical, routed through the on-call paging service
Info, routed through email
Warning, routed through SMS
All severities page the phone equally
questions.explain: Info and Warning post to a Teams channel via webhook; only Critical is routed to the paging service that rings her phone.

questions.q: What change made the log-space check 'sustained, not instant'?
options: Requiring log usage to stay at or above the warning threshold across several consecutive checks before alerting at all
Checking log usage only once per week instead of every five minutes
Removing the check entirely and relying on manual review
Lowering the warning threshold from 70% to 50%
questions.explain: A brief spike during the batch job's peak insert no longer counts on its own — the condition has to persist across multiple checks first.

questions.q: What is the actual goal of reducing alert fatigue, according to this lesson?
options: Alerts Priya can trust enough to act on, not simply fewer alerts for their own sake
Eliminating all alerts so nothing ever interrupts anyone
Making every alert page a phone regardless of severity
Replacing all monitoring with a nightly manual SSMS check again
questions.explain: The real win is fewer false positives and trustworthy severity routing, not silence — a real Critical condition still needs to reach Priya immediately.
